 Three more die of dengue, 1,674 get hospitalised
 Published : 8 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 8 November 2026, 01:36
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 At least three dengue patients died and 1,674 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Dhaka division and one in Barishal division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the total death toll has risen to 458, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,47,580.  Currently, 5,826 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
